title: How Different are Different Differences-in-Differences? A Large-Scale Meta-Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.39995v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: I use AI-assisted replication to assess the empirical importance of negative weights in two-way fixed effects (TWFE) estimation, analyzing 1,430 staggered-adoption specifications from 116 economics papers. TWFE estimates are highly correlated with modern difference-in-differences estimates, with sign reversals in 12.0-14.9% of comparisons and greater precision for TWFE. Hierarchical models accounting for estimation noise imply estimand correlations of 91-97% and a 0.7-2.4% probability of a statistically significant TWFE estimate opposing the modern estimand's sign. These findings suggest negative weights may be a less serious problem in practice and illustrate how AI can support systematic, large-scale empirical assessments of new econometric methods.

translated_title: 不同的双重差分法之间有多大差异？一项大规模元分析
translated_abstract: 我利用人工智能辅助的复制研究来评估双向固定效应（TWFE）估计中负权重的实证重要性，分析了来自116篇经济学论文的1,430个渐进采用规范。TWFE估计与现代双重差分估计高度相关，在12.0-14.9%的比较中出现符号反转，且TWFE具有更高的估计精度。考虑估计噪声的分层模型表明，估计对象之间的相关性为91-97%，统计显著的TWFE估计与现代估计对象符号相反的概率仅为0.7-2.4%。这些发现表明，负权重问题在实践中可能并不严重，同时展示了人工智能如何支持对新计量经济学方法进行系统性、大规模的实证评估。
tldr: 通过对116篇经济学论文中1,430个渐进采用规范的大规模AI辅助复制分析，本研究发现双向固定效应估计与现代双重差分估计高度相关，表明TWFE的负权重问题在实践中可能不如理论担忧的那样严重。
en_tdlr: This large-scale AI-assisted meta-analysis of 1,430 staggered-adoption specifications from 116 economics papers finds that TWFE estimates are highly correlated with modern difference-in-differences estimates, suggesting negative weights may be a less serious practical problem than previously feared.
